body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q2FY25 call (2024-11-08), prompted: "Customers are telling me second half next calendar year ... For construction. For small ag, again, it's a similar story" Metric: End-market recovery timing. Target: Small ag + construction growth in H2 CY2025; large ag CY2026. Deadline: 2025-12-31 (half-year). Specificity: vague. Status as of 2026-11-19: PARTLY. Evidence: Construction did recover from H2 CY2025 (Q2/Q3 FY26 calls: 'green', AI/data-centre demand; Q3FY26 revenue +35%). Small ag recovered only in India/Asia and Europe; North American small ag was still guided -5% to -10% in Nov-2025. Large ag: OEMs called Q4FY26 the trough (Q4FY26 call), so the 'CY2026' call looks right but is unresolved.
